# Security policy

## Maintained branch

The theme collection is maintained on `1.x`.

## Report a vulnerability

To report a vulnerability in Graupl Themes, [open an issue](https://github.com/Graupl/themes/issues/new) with the `security` label.

Maintainers review reports and prioritize fixes based on severity and impact.

## Vulnerabilities in Graupl

If the issue is in the Graupl framework, follow [Graupl's security policy](https://github.com/Graupl/graupl/blob/1.x/.github/SECURITY.md). Include the Graupl version or revision loaded by the affected preview when reporting a theme repository issue.
